_comment: Fantasy/exotic CROSS-SYSTEM sky presets (Sky lane #4 ST4-2). Each composes existing per-feature presets + tints: 'sun' = a data/sun_presets.json name, 'celestial' = a data/celestial_presets.json name; sky_tint/moon_color/moonlight_color are [r,g,b] multipliers/colors; other keys are lab_controls ids. NO time_of_day is set, so the LOOK holds as the ST4-1 day/night cycle runs (night-only bodies like the moon show when it's night). Picker on the Night tab + --fantasy=N.
